objective: Preallocate window function partition vectors from known row and partition counts.

tasks.title: Preallocate window partitions
tasks.result: Window function partition construction now preallocates all-row and partition-value vectors from known counts.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
Window partition membership, row indexes, partition key evaluation, and per-partition ordering were kept unchanged.
